sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.
